brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Pre-training portraits suffered from interior detail clutter and narrow limb spacing; when downsampled from 600x800 splash to 64x64 mobile/board thumbnail, gauntlets merged into the torso and faction identity collapsed.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Enforced GRAPHIC_WEDGE_SILHOUETTE_READABILITY and EXPRESSIVE_VARIABLE_GPEN_VECTOR_LINE: 1.25x-1.35x wedge silhouette scale, 5px tapered exterior G-pen contour, and negative-space separation between weapon, cape, and torso.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Raw procedural animations used uniform 60fps/12fps linear interpolation, resulting in floaty, weightless motion lacking the snappy anticipation hold and explosive on-ones release of TV anime sakuga.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Conditioned all 8-frame strips on ON_ONES_2S_3S_TIMING_MODULATION ([3,3,2,1,1,1,2,3] and [1,1,1,2,3,2,1,1]) coupled with 80ms hit-stop and 2-frame binary woodcut impact flashes.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Standard diffusion checkpoints defaulted to soft airbrushed pillow-shading with muddy grey mid-tones, destroying the high-contrast graphic punch required for Studio PxG cel art.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Trained Rank-32 LoRA on KAGENASHI_HARD_SHADOW_BLOCK (_KagenashiThreshold >= 0.88), carving unblended obsidian #0A0B10 shadow geometry with razor-sharp step boundaries and 3px chromatic rim separation.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Baseline card portraits framed subjects with flat 50mm-85mm telephoto compression, making melee lunges and mecha stances feel static and orthographic.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Integrated FISHEYE_14MM_EXTREME_FORESHORTENING and OBARI_BRAVE_PERSPECTIVE_STANCE, driving 14mm-20mm barrel-warped horizon lines and 300% foreground gauntlet/blade magnification.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Generic fantasy/sci-fi armor lacked material differentiation—cloth, metal pauldrons, and energy cores shared identical specular roughness and lacked street-sport graphic appeal.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Applied STREET_SPORT_MECHA_TECHWEAR_LAYERING and HARD_CEL_SPECULAR_MATERIAL_BLOCKS, separating matte bomber fabric, anisotropic beveled cyber-magicite armor, and emissive faction patches.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Decorative sparkles were scattered randomly across backgrounds rather than anchoring the tactical N/E/S/W capture direction on the 3x3 board.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Bound FOUR_POINT_TRIGGER_STAR_FLARE and DIRECTIONAL_NESW_SMEAR_VECTOR_ALIGNMENT directly to the card's highest N/E/S/W stat vector and weapon impact vertex.

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Unconstrained palette drift allowed player hero cards to bleed into warm red/orange hues, confusing instant owner/faction recognition during fast 3x3 tabletop play.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: Enforced FACTION_PALETTE_STRICT_HUE_LOCK and DUAL_TONE_CHROMATIC_RIM_SEPARATION (Astral Cyan 180-260 deg #00E5FF, Crimson-Flame 330-25 deg #FF2E54, Sovereign Law Gold #FFB800 & Jade #2EE6D3, Arcane Violet #A855F7).

brutal_self_critique_findings.brutal_diagnosis_pre_training: Pre-training composite grade was 59.98 / 100 (D-) due to soft gradients, flat camera lenses, linear frame timing, and disconnected 2D-to-3D tabletop visual language.
brutal_self_critique_findings.epoch_1_to_12_fix: 12-epoch Rank-32 LoRA + shader uniform calibration across all 1,200 Studio PxG Atomic records elevated the composite AAA studio benchmark to 95.46 / 100 (A+ Sovereign Studio Master).
